select cf.*,su.nickname as nickname,su.avatar as userAvatar,su.phone as userPhone FROM cms_feedback cf left JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = cf.user_id WHERE 1=1
AND ( cf.content LIKE concat(concat('%',#{params.keyword}),'%') or su.nickname LIKE concat(concat('%',#{params.keyword}),'%') or su.phone LIKE concat(concat('%',#{params.keyword}),'%') )
AND su.phone = #{params.userPhone}
ORDER BY cf.create_time desc
